requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer, including AI-driven print and scan workflows, and support for future AI enhancements.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require efficient, easy-to-manage solutions to reduce manual intervention and improve business workflows. AI solutions are a key differentiator and a top customer need.
requirements.Dependencies: SMB portal, hardware support for AI features
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-driven print and scan workflows are available and functional; user feedback indicates improved productivity; solution is integrated with SMB portal.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal specifically for SMBs to manage their printers, enabling device management, monitoring, and support for multiple devices in a small office environment.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs lack dedicated IT teams and need a simple, consolidated interface for managing their print infrastructure.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with AI solutions, telemetry requirements
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is available for SMB customers, supports management of multiple printers, provides monitoring and support features, and is user-friendly for non-IT staff.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Engineer Magellan to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO through efficient ink usage, minimal maintenance, and cost-effective supplies.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs, directly impacting purchasing decisions and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Keyed bottles, maintenance features, sustainability features
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent benchmarking confirms lowest TCO compared to competitors; customer feedback validates cost savings.

requirements.Title: High Sustainability with 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the plastic content in the Magellan printer is made from recycled materials, surpassing key competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and increasingly important for SMB customers and regulatory compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material certification verifies 60% RCP; documentation available for regulatory and marketing use.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer with a maintenance box that customers can easily replace themselves, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged SMBs lack IT support and need minimal intervention solutions to keep printers operational.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End-users can replace the maintenance box without technical assistance; instructional materials are clear; field testing validates ease of replacement.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user errors, improves reliability, and protects the printer from damage due to incorrect supplies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are uniquely keyed; only compatible bottles fit Magellan printers; field tests confirm effectiveness.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years (Whichever First)
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 printed pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance of durability and reliability to SMB customers, a key purchase consideration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly documented; warranty claims process is established; customers are informed at purchase.

requirements.Title: PHA and MINK Serviceability
requirements.Description: Design for serviceability such that PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center replaceable) components are clearly defined, with a target for most components to be customer replaceable if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime, service costs, and improves customer satisfaction among SMBs with limited IT support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service manual identifies PHA and MINK components; field testing confirms ease of replacement; customer support materials are available.

requirements.Title: Support for PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports PDL and PostScript printing for the PDL SKU, targeting business users with advanced printing needs.
requirements.Rationale: Business customers often require advanced print compatibility with enterprise software and workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL/PS printing is available and passes compatibility tests with common business applications.

requirements.Title: Improved Print Speed for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Increase print speed for PDL SKU to at least 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), improving over current 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Faster print speeds are essential for productivity in SMB environments and a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print speed for PDL SKU meets or exceeds 25/20 ppm in standard tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printer meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements for relevant SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are important for regulatory compliance and as a marketing differentiator in some regions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certification is achieved; documentation is available for marketing and regulatory use.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings, enabling integration with cloud-based solutions and services.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS support aligns with HP’s strategic goals for solution monetization and enhanced value for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS integration is tested and functional; customers can access cloud-based services through Magellan.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan Features
requirements.Description: Deliver advanced print and scan quality features branded as 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan', leveraging AI to optimize output and user experience.
requirements.Rationale: High quality and reliability in print/scan operations are key differentiators for SMB customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print and scan quality meets or exceeds defined benchmarks; user feedback confirms improved experience.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing with HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities via the HP App, supporting common mobile operating systems and workflows.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a standard expectation for SMBs and supports flexible work environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices using the HP App with no major issues reported in field tests.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement advanced telemetry to capture printer usage, health, and performance data for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and support.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry enables proactive support, maintenance, and solution enhancements, reducing downtime for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: SMB portal, firmware, data privacy compliance
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accurate, securely transmitted, and accessible via SMB portal; privacy requirements are met.
